items.title: Ukrainian bank workers released after detention in Hungary

items.summary: Ukraine has secured the release of seven Ukrainian bank workers arrested on Thursday in Hungary while transporting $80m (£60m) worth of cash and 9kg of gold in cash-transport vehicles to Ukraine.

items.title: US economy unexpectedly sheds 92,000 jobs in February

items.title: Watch: How war in Iran may affect food and fuel prices

items.summary: As the US and Israel continue strikes on Iran, and with retaliatory strikes hitting nearby Middle East states, key shipping routes are being disrupted. Oil and gas production in the region is also being affected.
items.summary_zh: 随着美国和以色列继续向伊朗出击,加上报复性打击袭击了附近的中东国家,关键航道正被打乱. 该区域的石油和天然气生产也受到影响。

items.title: Israel strikes Beirut after evacuation warning sparks panic

items.summary: Israel has launched airstrikes on Beirut, Lebanon, after ordering hundreds of thousands of people to leave the city's southern suburbs. There were no immediate reports of casualties.
items.summary_zh: 以色列在命令数十万人出城南郊后对黎巴嫩贝鲁特发动了空袭. 没有立即报告人员伤亡。

items.summary_zh: 美国官方将人工智能公司Anthropic视为供应链风险,为前所未有的法律斗争打下基础。

items.summary: Twenty-two-year-old Abeba Amdu has seen some of the best years of her life consumed by war - and she has no wish to see another conflict in Ethiopia's northern Tigray region, which some fear could be about to break out.
items.summary_zh: 22岁的阿贝巴·阿姆杜(Abeba Amdu)目睹了她一生中一些最美好的岁月被战争所消耗——她不想看到埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区再爆发冲突,有些恐惧可能即将爆发.

items.title: Finland plans to lift decades-old ban on hosting nuclear weapons

items.summary: Finland plans to lift its long-standing ban on having nuclear weapons on its territory, in a move the government says would align the country more closely with Nato's deterrence policy.
items.summary_zh: 芬兰计划解除其长期禁止在其领土上拥有核武器的禁令,政府称此举将使该国更紧密地配合纳托的威慑政策.

items.title: Trump cuts his losses on Noem after controversial tenure at homeland security

items.title: 'We have been preparing': Why the boots on the ground in Iran could be Kurdish

items.summary: For a sixth day, the US and Israel are battering targets in Iran, waging war from the air. Could there soon be boots on the ground? Maybe. But not American ones.
items.summary_zh: 第六天,美国和以色列正在伊朗打击目标,从空中发动战争。 可能很快就有靴子在地上吗? 也许吧 但不是美国人。

items.title: Iran's high-risk war strategy seems to centre on endurance and deterrence
items.title_zh: 伊朗的高风险战争战略似乎以耐力和威慑为中心
items.summary: Iran's military posture in a widening conflict with Israel and the US suggests it is not fighting for victory in any conventional sense. It is fighting for survival, and survival on its own terms.
items.summary_zh: 伊朗在与以色列日益扩大的冲突中的军事姿态和美国表示,它不是在任何常规意义上为胜利而战. 它正在以自己的条件为生存而斗争。
